cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(jazzplusplus VERSION 5.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# Compiler warning flags
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
    add_compile_options(-Wall -Wno-unknown-pragmas -Wno-deprecated-declarations)
endif()

# Find wxWidgets
find_package(wxWidgets REQUIRED core base adv net html)
include(${wxWidgets_USE_FILE})

# Find ALSA
find_package(ALSA REQUIRED)

# Generate config.h in build directory
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config.h
"// Generated by CMake for Jazz++
#pragma once

#define HAVE_CONFIG_H 1
#define DEV_ALSA 1
#define DEV_SEQUENCER2 1
#define PACKAGE \"jazzplusplus\"
#define VERSION \"5.0.0\"
")

# Include directories
include_directories(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/Bitmaps
    ${ALSA_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    ${wxWidgets_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)

# Global preprocessor definitions
add_definitions(
    -DHAVE_CONFIG_H
    -DDEV_ALSA
    -DDEV_SEQUENCER2
    -DJAZZ_DATADIR="${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/share/jazz"
)

set(JAZZ_SOURCES
    src/AboutDialog.cpp
    src/AlsaDriver.cpp
    src/AlsaPlayer.cpp
    src/AlsaThru.cpp
    src/ArrayControl.cpp
    src/AsciiMidiFile.cpp
    src/Audio.cpp
    src/AudioDriver.cpp
    src/Command.cpp
    src/Configuration.cpp
    src/ControlEdit.cpp
    src/DeprecatedWx/prop.cpp
    src/DeprecatedWx/propform.cpp
    src/DeprecatedWx/proplist.cpp
    src/Dialogs/AudioSettingsDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/CleanupDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/ControllerDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/DeleteDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/EndOfTrackDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/FilterDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/IntegerEdit.cpp
    src/Dialogs/LengthDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/KeyOnDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/MeterChangeDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/MetronomeSettingsDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/MidiChannelDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/PitchWheelDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/ProgramChangeDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/QuantizeDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/SamplesDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/SearchAndReplaceDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/SetTempoDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/ShiftDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/SnapDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/SynthesizerSettingsDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/SysexDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/TextDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/TrackDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/TransposeDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs/VelocityDialog.cpp
    src/Dialogs.cpp
    src/DrumUtilities.cpp
    src/ErrorMessage.cpp
    src/Events.cpp
    src/EventFrame.cpp
    src/EventWindow.cpp
    src/FileSelector.cpp
    src/Filter.cpp
    src/FindFile.cpp
    src/FrequencyTable.cpp
    src/GetOptionIndex.cpp
    src/Globals.cpp
    src/GuitarFrame.cpp
    src/GuitarSettings.cpp
    src/GuitarSettingsDialog.cpp
    src/GuitarWindow.cpp
    src/HarmonyBrowserAnalyzer.cpp
    src/Harmony.cpp
    src/HarmonyP.cpp
    src/Help.cpp
    src/JazzPlusPlusApplication.cpp
    src/KeyStringConverters.cpp
    src/Knob.cpp
    src/Mapper.cpp
    src/MeasureChoice.cpp
    src/MidiDeviceDialog.cpp
    src/Metronome.cpp
    src/MouseAction.cpp
    src/NamedChoice.cpp
    src/NamedValue.cpp
    src/NamedValueChoice.cpp
    src/PianoFrame.cpp
    src/PianoWindow.cpp
    src/Player.cpp
    src/Project.cpp
    src/ProjectManager.cpp
    src/PropertyListDialog.cpp
    src/Random.cpp
    src/RecordingInfo.cpp
    src/Rectangle.cpp
    src/Rhythm.cpp
    src/RhythmArrayControl.cpp
    src/Sample.cpp
    src/SampleCommand.cpp
    src/SampleDialog.cpp
    src/SampleFrame.cpp
    src/SampleWindow.cpp
    src/SelectControllerDialog.cpp
    src/Signal2.cpp
    src/SliderWindow.cpp
    src/Song.cpp
    src/StandardFile.cpp
    src/StringReadWrite.cpp
    src/StringUtilities.cpp
    src/Synth.cpp
    src/SysexChannel.cpp
    src/ToolBar.cpp
    src/Track.cpp
    src/TrackFrame.cpp
    src/TrackWindow.cpp
)

add_executable(jazz ${JAZZ_SOURCES})

target_link_libraries(jazz PRIVATE
    ${wxWidgets_LIBRARIES}
    ${ALSA_LIBRARIES}
    m
    pthread
)

include(GNUInstallDirs)
install(TARGETS jazz RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
install(FILES jazz.desktop DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/applications)
install(DIRECTORY conf/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/jazz/conf)
install(DIRECTORY song/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/jazz/song)
